versions.changelog: No content changes; provenance now points at the checked-in build under clawhub/dist
Bundle domain modules as reference files so a single install carries the full endpoint documentation

Initial release – manage all core functions of your doxx.net private network.

- Set up, update, and manage WireGuard tunnels for desktop, mobile, and native apps.
- Administer firewall rules, mesh networking, and access controls.
- Register, import, and manage domains and DNS records.
- Configure DNS blocking, manage blocklists/whitelists, and enable secure DNS.
- List, rename, and remove devices; assign and rotate IP addresses.
- View bandwidth stats, security alerts, and manage account settings.
- Create and manage authentication tokens with fine-grained controls.
- Includes a guided network setup wizard for new deployments.
